historical_references.context: The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said, 'The believer's shroud will be the garment in which he was clothed when he was granted martyrdom.' A man came forward and said, 'I have given my clothes as alms, and I have nothing except this shirt that I am wearing.' Azzat bin As-Said said, 'Let me buy it from him.' The Prophet (pbuh) said, 'Leave him, for it will be a source of coolness for him on the Day of Resurrection.'

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah, Volume 13, Page 190. The name Azzat carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Azzat bin As-Said Al-Qurashi: He was one of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for his generosity and kindness. He used to provide the Prophet (pbuh) and his companions with food and clothes. He was so called because he was always ready to help others in times of need, and his name meant 'the constant giver.'
